A list of spells available to be prepared by the Cleric class.

Overview

Cleric spells are Prepared spells, so all Clerics have access to these spells (up to their Cleric level) and prepare a limited number of them at any one time.

Cleric spells use the caster's Wisdom modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
